title: AI-based structure prediction empowers integrative structural analysis of human nuclear pores.
authors: Mosalaganti, Shyamal; Obarska-Kosinska, Agnieszka; Siggel, Marc; Taniguchi, Reiya; Turonova, Beata; Zimmerli, Christian E; Buczak, Katarzyna; Schmidt, Florian H; Margiotta, Erica; Mackmull, Marie-Therese; Hagen, Wim J H; Hummer, Gerhard; Kosinski, Jan; Beck, Martin
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI结构预测与整合建模解析人类核孔复合物支架，涵盖无序连接NUP的锚定位点并做粗粒化MD模拟，虽对象为核孔而非典型IDP-PPI，但无序蛋白在复合物中的定位与机制建模思路对本课题有迁移启发。
abstract: INTRODUCTION The eukaryotic nucleus pro-tects the genome and is enclosed by the two membranes of the nuclear envelope. Nuclear pore complexes (NPCs) perforate the nuclear envelope to facilitate nucleocytoplasmic transport. With a molecular weight of  approximately 120 MDa, the human NPC is one of the larg-est protein complexes. Its ~1000 proteins are taken in multiple copies from a set of about 30 distinct nucleoporins (NUPs). They can be roughly categorized into two classes. Scaf-fold NUPs contain folded domains and form a cylindrical scaffold architecture around a central channel. Intrinsically disordered NUPs line the scaffold and extend into the central channel, where they interact with cargo complexes. The NPC architecture is highly dynamic. It responds to changes in nuclear envelope tension with conforma-tional breathing that manifests in dilation and constriction movements. Elucidating the scaffold architecture, ultimately at atomic resolution, will be important for gaining a more precise understanding of NPC function and dynamics but imposes a substantial chal-lenge for structural biologists. RATIONALE Considerable progress has been made toward this goal by a joint effort in the field. A synergistic combination of complementary approaches has turned out to be critical. In situ structural biology techniques were used to reveal the overall layout of the NPC scaffold that defines the spatial reference for molecular modeling. High-resolution structures of many NUPs were determined in vitro. Proteomic analysis and extensive biochemical work unraveled the interaction network of NUPs. Integra-tive modeling has been used to combine the different types of data, resulting in a rough outline of the NPC scaffold. Previous struc-tural models of the human NPC, however, were patchy and limited in accuracy owing to several challenges: (i) Many of the high-resolution structures of individual NUPs have been solved from distantly related species and, consequently, do not comprehensively cover their human counterparts. (ii) The scaf-fold is interconnected by a set of intrinsically disordered linker NUPs that are not straight-forwardly accessible to common structural biology techniques. (iii) The NPC scaffold intimately embraces the fused inner and outer nuclear membranes in a distinctive topol-ogy and cannot be studied in isolation. (iv) The conformational dynamics of scaffold NUPs limits the resolution achievable in structure determination. RESULTS In this study, we used artificial intelligence (AI)-based prediction to generate an exten-sive repertoire of structural models of human NUPs and their subcomplexes. The resulting models cover various domains and interfaces that so far remained structurally uncharac-terized. Benchmarking against previous and unpublished x-ray and cryo-electron micros-copy structures revealed unprecedented accu-racy. We obtained well-resolved cryo-electron tomographic maps of both the constricted and dilated conformational states of the hu-man NPC. Using integrative modeling, we fit-ted the structural models of individual NUPs into the cryo-electron microscopy maps. We explicitly included several linker NUPs and traced their trajectory through the NPC scaf-fold. We elucidated in great detail how mem-brane-associated and transmembrane NUPs are distributed across the fusion topology of both nuclear membranes. The resulting architectural model increases the structural coverage of the human NPC scaffold by about twofold. We extensively validated our model against both earlier and new experimental data. The completeness of our model has enabled microsecond-long coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of the NPC scaffold within an explicit membrane en-vironment and solvent. These simulations reveal that the NPC scaffold prevents the constriction of the otherwise stable double-membrane fusion pore to small diameters in the absence of membrane tension. CONCLUSION Our 70-MDa atomically re-solved model covers >90% of the human NPC scaffold. It captures conforma-tional changes that occur during dilation and constriction. It also reveals the precise anchoring sites for intrinsically disordered NUPs, the identification of which is a prerequisite for a complete and dy-namic model of the NPC. Our study exempli-fies how AI-based structure prediction may accelerate the elucidation of subcellular ar-chitecture at atomic resolution. [Figure: see text].
abstract_zh:
引言 真核细胞核保护基因组，并由核被膜的两层膜包裹。核孔复合体（NPCs）贯穿核被膜，以促进核质运输。人源NPC分子量约为120 MDa，是最大的蛋白质复合体之一。其约1000个蛋白质由约30种不同的核孔蛋白（NUPs）以多个拷贝形式组成，大致可分为两类：支架核孔蛋白含有折叠结构域，围绕中央通道形成圆柱形支架结构； intrinsically disordered核孔蛋白沿支架排列并延伸至中央通道，与货物复合体相互作用。NPC结构高度动态，响应核被膜张力变化，表现为扩张和收缩运动的构象呼吸。阐明支架结构，最终达到原子分辨率，对于更精确理解NPC功能和动态至关重要，但对结构生物学家构成重大挑战。

理由 该领域通过联合努力已取得显著进展。互补方法的协同组合被证明至关重要。原位结构生物学技术用于揭示NPC支架的整体布局，为分子建模提供空间参考。许多核孔蛋白的高分辨率结构在体外被解析。蛋白质组学分析和广泛的生化工作揭示了核孔蛋白的相互作用网络。整合建模用于结合不同类型的数据，得出NPC支架的粗略轮廓。然而，先前的人源NPC结构模型因若干挑战而零散且精度有限：（i）许多单个核孔蛋白的高分辨率结构来自远缘物种，因此未全面覆盖其人类对应物。（ii）支架通过一组 intrinsically disordered连接核孔蛋白相互连接，这些蛋白不易通过常见结构生物学技术研究。（iii）NPC支架以独特拓扑紧密包围融合的内外核膜，无法孤立研究。（iv）支架核孔蛋白的构象动态限制了结构测定中可实现的分辨率。

结果 在本研究中，我们使用基于人工智能（AI）的预测生成人源核孔蛋白及其亚复合体的广泛结构模型库。所得模型覆盖了迄今结构未表征的各种结构域和界面。与先前及未发表的X射线和冷冻电子显微镜结构进行基准测试，显示出前所未有的准确性。我们获得了人源NPC收缩和扩张构象状态的高分辨率冷冻电子断层扫描图谱。通过整合建模，我们将单个核孔蛋白的结构模型拟合到冷冻电子显微镜图谱中。我们明确包含了几种连接核孔蛋白，并追踪了它们通过NPC支架的路径。我们详细阐明了膜相关和跨膜核孔蛋白如何分布在整个核膜融合拓扑中。所得结构模型将人源NPC支架的结构覆盖率提高了约两倍。我们针对早期和新的实验数据广泛验证了模型。模型的完整性使我们能够在显式膜环境和溶剂中进行微秒级粗粒化分子动力学模拟。这些模拟揭示，在无膜张力情况下，NPC支架阻止了本应稳定的双膜融合孔收缩至小直径。

结论 我们的70-MDa原子分辨率模型覆盖了人源NPC支架的>90%。它捕捉了扩张和收缩过程中发生的构象变化，并揭示了intrinsically disordered核孔蛋白的精确锚定位点，这是完整动态NPC模型的先决条件。我们的研究 exemplifies 基于AI的结构预测如何加速亚细胞结构在原子分辨率下的阐明。[图见正文]。
